title: Customer discovery call
description: The customer's context, current solution, problems with frequency and severity, jobs to be done, buying signals and next steps.

summary.description: Three to five sentences on what the session covered and what matters most.

customerProfile.description: Job role, industry or customer segment, and the approximate size of the organisation if mentioned. No names.

currentSolution.description: How they solve the problem today (tools, processes, people) and what it costs them.

problem.description: The problem in the customer's terms.

frequency.description: How often it happens, if stated.

severity.description: How much it hurts, judged from the evidence.

evidence.description: Quotes that show the problem. At most 3.

timestamp.description: Approximate position in the recording (mm:ss or h:mm:ss), if known.

jobsToBeDone.description: What the customer is ultimately trying to achieve.

willingnessToPay.description: Budget, price expectations or spend on current solutions. "not discussed" if absent.

decisionProcess.description: Who decides and how purchases are made. "not discussed" if absent.

objections.description: Concerns, blockers or reasons not to buy.

notableQuotes.description: The most telling quotes, most telling first. At most 10.

timestamp.description: Approximate position in the recording (mm:ss or h:mm:ss), if known.

nextSteps.description: Agreed follow-ups and open hypotheses to test.
